description: Estat d'obertura dels equipaments turístics Port Ainé is a dataset listed in Dades Obertes FGC open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ferrocarrils de la Generalitat de Catalunya (FGC). Informació de l'estat d'obertura de les instal·lacions i serveis dels equipaments turístics de Port Ainé. Coverage: Catalonia (Ferrocarrils de la Generalitat de Catalunya network). The portal files it under Turisme. Its keywords are estacions de muntanya, transports turístics, Port Ainé, estat d'obertura, infoneu, estat del servei. The portal shows 41 records. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution License 4.0 (cc-by 4.0) (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-dadesobertes-fgc-cat-portal.
